# Approved breaking-change exceptions

Lines below are matched by `oasdiff breaking --err-ignore` against error-level findings (see
`docs/CONFIG-FILES.md` / `docs/BREAKING-CHANGES.md` in oasdiff/oasdiff for the format: each
pattern line names the method+path and enough of the finding text to identify it). Every entry
here must be reviewed and approved before merge - this file is not a place to silence CI, it is
a record of contract changes the team decided are acceptable and why.

Approved 2026-09-16 (PR #328): this route let any caller silently overwrite an inventory row's
quantity with no audit trail and no site scoping. `.specs/phase-6-inventory/review.md` (finding
A-5) and `log.md`'s "Dropping the untracked PUT" entry record the team's confirmed decision to
delete it rather than resurrect it behind auth/audit, since the project's design now has exactly
one way to mutate quantity - the audited `POST /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/inventory/adjustments`
endpoint - and deliberately does not offer an audited "set absolute quantity" equivalent. No web
caller has used the legacy route since that endpoint shipped (`apps/web/src/lib/api/site-inventory.ts`).

PUT /api/locations/{locationId}/inventory/{inventoryId} api removed without deprecation
